title: Travelling Alone in Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **Choose one anchor first.** Alexanderplatz and Museum Island suit a history-led day, Tiergarten suits a quieter day, and Kottbusser Tor can work when you want neighbourhood life rather than a checklist.
**Add one hinge, not five extra sights.** Let a museum area, a park pause or a food stop decide whether the day continues.
**Check the live connection before moving.** BVG service, construction and night transport patterns can change, so use the official connection search shortly before you leave each place.

**Use a tour when conversation is the missing piece.** BerlinWalk's tip-based public walk starts at the World Clock on Alexanderplatz and lasts about 2 hours through the historic centre of former East Berlin.
Use the Berlin Solo Day Path to turn your mood into one anchor, one hinge and one honest finish.
